# iosxe_voice_class_tls_cipher (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class TLS Cipher configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_tls_cipher" "example" {
  tag = 1
  ciphers = [
    {
      preference   = 1
      cipher_suite = "ECDHE_RSA_AES256_GCM_SHA384"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class srtp-crypto tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `ciphers` (Attributes List) TLS cipher-suite (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ciphers))
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--ciphers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ciphers`

Required:

- `preference` (Number) Set the preference order for the cipher-suite (1 = Highest)
  - Range: `1`-`13`

Optional:

- `cipher_suite` (String) - Choices: `AES128_GCM_SHA256`, `AES256_GCM_SHA384`, `CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256`, `DHE_RSA_AES128_GCM_SHA256`, `DHE_RSA_AES256_GCM_SHA384`, `DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA`, `DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA`, `ECDHE_ECDSA_AES128_GCM_SHA256`, `ECDHE_ECDSA_AES256_GCM_SHA384`, `ECDHE_RSA_AES128_GCM_SHA256`, `ECDHE_RSA_AES256_GCM_SHA384`, `RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA`, `RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_tls_cipher.example "<tag>"
```
